integrity: New proof supplied with independent exact checks; finite simulations do not prove the theorem. Independent expert review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only simultaneous deterministic speed-v>=2 Fukui-Ishibashi traffic on low-density labelled cyclic rings n>=(v+1)m, m>=2. Historical priority not conclusively established because original 1996 and short 1997 full texts were unavailable; speed-one Catalan theorem already published. Fixed-v and fixed-surplus asymptotics only. No claim about high-density, stochastic models or other relaxation observables.
title: Raney-forest extremizers of high-speed cyclic traffic relaxation
